PERSONAL AUTO POLICY - DECLARATIONS
Policy Number: PA-241058
Named Insured: Samuel O. Baker
Policy Period Start: 11/01/2025
Policy Period End: 11/01/2026
Continuous Coverage Since: 01/03/2014
Covered Vehicle: 2021 Honda Civic LX, VIN UKL0T2FSP3UR56J24
Bodily Injury Liability Limit: $250,000 each person / $500,000 each accident
Property Damage Liability Limit: $50,000 each accident
Uninsured/Underinsured Motorist Limit: $100,000 each person / $300,000 each accident
Medical Payments Limit: $2,500 each person
Collision Deductible: $1,000
Comprehensive Deductible: $250
Rental Reimbursement: $40 per day / $1,200 maximum
Total Policy Premium: $1,844.86

POLICY TERMS

SECTION 2.1 - Liability Coverage
We will pay damages for bodily injury or property damage for which an insured is legally responsible because of an auto accident. We will settle or defend, as we consider appropriate, any claim or suit asking for these damages. Our duty to settle or defend ends when our limit of liability has been paid.

SECTION 2.2 - Liability Exclusions
We do not provide Liability Coverage for any person for bodily injury or property damage arising from the ownership or use of a vehicle while it is being used to carry persons or property for a fee. This does not apply to a share-the-expense car pool.

SECTION 2.3 - Uninsured Motorist Coverage
We will pay compensatory damages which an insured is legally entitled to recover from the owner or operator of an uninsured motor vehicle because of bodily injury sustained by the insured, up to the limit shown in the Declarations.

SECTION 3.1 - Duties After an Accident or Loss
A person seeking coverage must notify us promptly of an accident or loss, and in any event within 14 days. The person must also cooperate with us in the investigation and settlement of any claim.

SECTION 3.2 - Collision Coverage
We will pay for direct and accidental loss to your covered auto caused by collision, less the applicable deductible shown in the Declarations. Payment will not exceed the lesser of the actual cash value of the damaged property or the amount necessary to repair or replace it.

SECTION 3.3 - Comprehensive Coverage
We will pay for direct and accidental loss to your covered auto not caused by collision, including fire, theft, vandalism, flood, and contact with animals, less the applicable deductible shown in the Declarations.

SECTION 3.4 - Rental Reimbursement
If your covered auto is withdrawn from use for more than 24 hours because of a covered loss, we will reimburse transportation expenses up to the daily and maximum amounts shown in the Declarations.

SECTION 4.1 - Policy Territory
Coverage applies only to accidents and losses occurring within the United States, its territories and possessions, or Canada.

SECTION 4.2 - Other Insurance
If there is other applicable insurance, we will pay only our share of the loss. Our share is the proportion that our limit bears to the total of all applicable limits. Any insurance we provide for a vehicle you do not own is excess over any other collectible insurance.

SECTION 5.1 - Cancellation
You may cancel this policy at any time by notifying us. We may cancel by mailing notice to the named insured at the address shown in the Declarations at least 30 days before the effective date of cancellation, or 15 days if cancellation is for nonpayment of premium.

SECTION 5.2 - Fraud and Misrepresentation
We do not provide coverage for any insured who has knowingly concealed or misrepresented any material fact or circumstance in connection with this policy or a claim.

SECTION 5.3 - Changes to This Policy
This policy contains all the agreements between you and us. Its terms may be changed only by an endorsement issued by us.

SECTION 7.10 - Medical Payments Eligibility
Medical expenses are covered for an insured who is injured while occupying a covered auto. Expenses must be incurred within the period shown in the Declarations and must be reasonable and necessary.

SECTION 7.1 - Appraisal
If we and an insured disagree on the amount of a loss, either party may demand an appraisal. Each party selects a competent appraiser, and the two appraisers select an umpire. A decision agreed by any two of the three is binding on both parties.

SECTION 7.11 - Uninsured Motorist Property Damage
We pay for damage to your covered auto caused by an uninsured motorist, after the deductible shown in the Declarations is applied. The at-fault motorist must be identified.

SECTION 7.12 - Subrogation Detail
If we make a payment under this policy, we may recover it from any person or organization responsible for the loss. An insured must do nothing after a loss to impair these rights and must help us enforce them.

SECTION 7.13 - Notice Delivery
Notice of cancellation or non-renewal is delivered when mailed to the address shown in the Declarations. Proof of mailing is sufficient proof of notice.

SECTION 7.3 - Newly Acquired Vehicle
A vehicle you become the owner of during the policy period is covered if it replaces a covered auto, or if it is an additional vehicle and you ask us to insure it promptly after you acquire it. Coverage for an additional vehicle begins on the date you acquire it.

SECTION 7.4 - Cooperation and Examination
An insured must cooperate with us and submit to an examination under oath when we reasonably request it. The examination will take place at a location we reasonably choose.

SECTION 7.5 - Total Loss Settlement
If the cost to repair a covered auto exceeds its actual cash value, we may treat the loss as a total loss and pay the actual cash value less the deductible. We keep the salvage unless you retain the vehicle, in which case the salvage value is deducted.

SECTION 7.7 - Custom Equipment
We cover custom parts and equipment permanently installed in your covered auto up to the amount shown in the Declarations. You must be able to document the installation date and original cost.

SECTION 7.9 - Transport Between Ports
Coverage also applies while a covered auto is transported between ports of the places listed in the Policy Territory section, provided the transport is arranged by you or by a carrier you hire.
